ja159:1.1: “That One who gives Vision, the sole king, comes up,
ja159:1.2: he is golden coloured, he enlightens the earth,
ja159:1.3: therefore I revere the golden coloured one, who enlightens the earth,
ja159:1.4: guarded by you today, we will live out the day.
ja159:2.1: ° I revere those brahmins who have true understanding
ja159:2.2: of all things - may they keep watch over me!
ja159:2.4: Reverence to the Free! Reverence to Freedom!”
ja159:2.6: the peacock roams about seeking (for food).
ja159:3.1: “That One who gives Vision, the sole king, goes down,
ja159:3.2: he is golden coloured, he enlightens the earth,
ja159:3.3: therefore I revere the golden coloured one, who enlightens the earth,
ja159:3.4: guarded by you today, we will live out the night.
ja159:4.1: ° I revere those brahmins who have true understanding
ja159:4.2: of all things - may they keep watch over me!
ja159:4.4: Reverence to the Free! Reverence to Freedom!”
